module.title: Docker container checker
module.description: Check docker containers (state, health) and the docker daemon itself.
module.name: CheckDocker

commands.check_docker: Check the state of docker containers, optionally requiring specific containers to be running.
commands.check_docker_info: Check that the docker daemon is healthy: version plus container and image counts.
commands.check_docker_stats: Check per-container resource usage: CPU percent and memory versus limit.
commands.check_docker_restarts: Detect container restart loops and out-of-memory kills.
commands.check_docker_df: Check docker disk usage: images, containers, volumes, build cache and reclaimable space.
